note: Fresh exploratory cases annotated before calls. Complete endpoints do not prove correct artwork or mechanism.

cases.text: A transmitter sends light through an optical fibre to a detector. A technician watches the detector.
A speaker sends sound through air to a microphone, while a student stands beside the speaker.
An oscillator sends vibration through a membrane to a sensor. The sensor sends a reading to a display.
A laser sends light through glass to a detector.
